_comment: Model packs this build knows how to install. See docs/model-packs.md.
Publishing a pack is two steps - Scripts/package_model_pack.sh to build and
checksum it, then an entry here naming the release asset it was uploaded as.
An entry is the whole switch: with one, EngineWeightsPreparation installs the
verified pack instead of letting the engine fetch its own weights; without
one, the app downloads them exactly as it always has.
Every field is checked by ModelPackManifest.parse before anything is
downloaded: the URL must be HTTPS on a GitHub release host under this
repository, the sha256 must be 64 hex characters, and cacheFolder and each
entry must be a single path component.
appear, which is exactly one - SenseVoiceSmall, under the FunASR Model Open
Source License v1.1. docs/speech-model-attribution.md is what grants that,
and no other model may be listed until the same paragraph is written for it.
